tools.description: Search the headlesslaw corpus: the verbatim text of EU financial and digital regulation (Level 1 acts, their Level 2 technical standards and Level 3 guidelines and Q&As) and the definitions. tools.name: getPage
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown of one page of the headlesslaw corpus by its address (for example https://www.headlesslaw.com/mica/articles/3). The page carries the verbatim official text, its status line and its official source, plus links to related provisions and documents that you can follow with getPag

tools.name: sendFeedback
tools.description: Report a problem with a page of the headlesslaw corpus to its maintainers: text that differs from the official source, a broken or wrong link, missing content or an outdated status. tools.description: Deterministic search over the provisions and documents of the corpus (citation resolver first, then keyword and semantic legs fused by rank). Returns provision objects with their URLs, match basis, status/version/check line, as_of, coverage and limits; a zero is never returned without what was searc

tools.name: resolve_citation
tools.description: Resolve a citation string to the provision (or act) it names, with its URL. Citation-shaped input only; nothing is ranked. Forms: 'Art 75(3)(a) MiCA', 'point (a) of Article 75(3) MiCA', 'Article 75 paragraph 3 MiCA', 'Recital 22 MiCA', 'Recital (22) MiCA', 'recital 22 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114',

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: One Level 2 or Level 3 document (a technical standard, guideline, Q&A, opinion …) with its information block and text.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: The versions of a provision we hold: each with its validity interval, version permalink, the consolidation it comes from, its revisions (corrigenda, repairs) with immutable revision URLs, held-back changes and application dates.

tools.name: get_definition
tools.description: A defined term in its governing act: the defining provision's text, its URL and the definition page. `text` is the definition without the page's list of provisions that use the term; `used_in` gives their count and the page that lists them.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
